text: AI is changing how we create art, music, and writing. Today, computers can produce paintings, compose songs, and even write stories. Some people are amazed by this, while others feel worried. Can a machine really be creative? AI learns from millions of examples and then makes something new. However, it does not have feelings, personal experiences, or true imagination. Human creativity comes from emotions, memories, and life itself. So perhaps AI is not a replacement, but a tool. It can help artists and writers explore new ideas, but the heart of creativity will always stay human.
